security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Open, read, edit, and save one local Markdown file.
bundle.longDescription: Ray Markdown Reader is a focused, offline-first Markdown and plain-text reader and editor for Android. Open one local file, switch between full-screen preview and editing, and save changes back to the same file.
